titleJa: 中2 Lesson 3 Goal — 『捨てないパン屋』田村さん（Read + Write・p.33–35）
title: M2 L3 Goal — Mr. Tamura bakery article (Read + Write)
readingPassages: Goal Activity — Read + Write
『捨てないパン屋』ができるまで — ウェブマガジン：田村陽至さん
As We Grow, Dreams Change
1. Mr. Tamura is a baker. He loves to bake bread. However, when he was a child, he did not like bread.

2. As a child, Mr. Tamura loved nature. He explored the forest behind his house. One day he saw some people in the forest. They were cutting down trees to build a building. They destroyed his favorite place. This shocked him.

3. After Mr. Tamura studied the environment at university, he became a nature guide. He went to Mongolia and gave tours to Japanese tourists. There, he stayed with herders. They lived simply and wasted nothing. This impressed him.

4. When Mr. Tamura returned to Japan, his parents were having trouble with their bakery. He was worried, so he decided to help them. He found a major problem with the bakery. It had many leftovers every day because it made too many kinds of bread.

5. Mr. Tamura started to make only a few kinds of bread and to bake less of it. When he had leftovers, he visited local restaurants and shops to sell the last few loaves. That way, he sold every loaf. This system was simple and kind to the environment.
6. Now the bakery makes only four kinds of bread and wastes nothing. Many people love the bread and the bakery itself. Mr. Tamura's dream is to share his knowledge with young bakers.
Read — Guide 3（パン店の問題）:
問題: 毎日多くの商品が残る／原因: パンの種類が多すぎた／解決: 種類を減らす・売れ残りを地域の店に売る
Goal — 並べよう（田村さんの話）:
(e) I worked as a nature guide in Mongolia.
(d) I found a problem with my parents' bakery.
(a) I decided to make only a few kinds of bread.
(c) I sold bread to local restaurants and shops.
(b) I learned to live simply and waste nothing.
（目安の順: e → d → a → c → b）
Write — 田村さんへの質問の例:
Why did you decide to help your parents?

items.meaningJa: しかし、子どものころはパンが好きではなかった。
彼らは建物を建てるために木を切り倒していた。
モンゴルに行き、日本人観光客にツアーをした。
彼らは質素に暮らし、何も無駄にしなかった。
心配したので、両親を助けることに決めた。
パンの種類を作りすぎたので、毎日たくさんの食べ残しがあった。
食べ残しがあるとき、地域のレストランや店に最後の数斤を売りに行った。
その方法で、すべてのパンを売った。
今、そのパン屋は4種類のパンだけを作り、何も無駄にしない。
田村さんの夢は、若いパン職人に知識を共有することだ。
